supported_scope: Native skill bundles use SKILL.md instructions and optional resources; the App discovers supported skill locations and provides invocation controls.

required_setup: Assess discovery and invocation only; adding a custom skill or plugin remains excluded from this baseline.
constraints: The capability mechanism is in scope; behavior of an installed third-party skill is not.
